fusions.name: Lazy Shove
fusions.desc: Nudges an enemy up to 3 tiles away with your shield, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Swell
fusions.desc: Rolls your shield outward in a heavy swell, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. When it lands, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Becalmed
fusions.desc: Spends 1 second settling behind your shield, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 4 seconds. Afterwards they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Buoyant Bulk
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you have 10% water resistance.
